versions.content: The function Fr_SetWakeupChannel shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Change the CC’s POCState to POC:config by invoking the CHI command ‘CONFIG’. 2. Configure the wakeup channel according to parameter Fr_ChnlIdx. 3. Change the CC’s POCState to POC:ready again by invoking the CHI command ‘CONFIG_COMPLETE’. 4. Return E_OK.
